title.value: Modernize a learning repo and open the first PR

introduction.value: A tutorial author had Devin bump dependencies, add lint rules and scripts, and open a PR on an exercises repo, with later parts planning a UI and feature PRs.

method.value: Marie Fayard connected Devin to her old fp-ts-exercises repo, limiting access to that one repo. She ran the prompt through Devin's Analyze prompt feature and asked for dependency updates, a Mocha-to-Vitest migration, and a PR. Devin proposed a plan and she confirmed it. Mid-run she asked for lint and TypeScript-check scripts, and Devin added them. It then opened a PR, and she fixed the broken scripts herself.

outcome.value: The PR arrived within minutes with an accurate description, and Devin also tested extra exercises. The lint and compile scripts failed because package.json lacked type:module, which took the author about 7 minutes to fix. The session used 1.7 ACUs, about $3.83.

source_text.body:
Modernize a learning repo and open the first PR
A tutorial author had Devin bump dependencies, add lint rules and scripts, and open a PR on an exercises repo, with later parts planning a UI and feature PRs.
Done with
DE
Devin
What they did
Marie Fayard connected Devin to her old fp-ts-exercises repo, limiting access to that one repo. She ran the prompt through Devin's Analyze prompt feature and asked for dependency updates, a Mocha-to-Vitest migration, and a PR. Devin proposed a plan and she confirmed it. Mid-run she asked for lint and TypeScript-check scripts, and Devin added them. It then opened a PR, and she fixed the broken scripts herself.
How it went
The PR arrived within minutes with an accurate description, and Devin also tested extra exercises. The lint and compile scripts failed because package.json lacked type:module, which took the author about 7 minutes to fix. The session used 1.7 ACUs, about $3.83.
Worth knowing
The Plans page showed a stale ACU balance for about 18 hours, so use the Usage & Limits page. Terminate or sleep the session when done.
Try it yourself
with
Devin
Copy prompt
Modernize my learning repo at [repo URL]: update outdated dependencies, add lint rules and helpful npm or build scripts, and make sure everything still runs. Open one pull request with a clear description of each change and how to run the project. Don't merge, and don't start on new features until I've reviewed it.
Original source: https://www.datacamp.com/tutorial/devin-ai
